name: SEATED IN & OUTS
introduce: Sit on a bench, put your hands behind you and grab the bench, lean your body backward. \n\nLift your legs, bend your knees and bring your knees toward your chest. Fully extend your legs and repeat.

tips.text: Squeeze your abs with each crunch.
Please do it slowly to feel the squeezing.
Exhale when bringing your knees to your chest, and inhale when extending your legs.
This exercise targets your lower abdominal muscles.
